column3: Checks players missing training: n/250 consecutive people from a random one; a present player with training and without a serious injury misses training (`exe::awol_miss_training`) by a random draw on the sum of attributes, work rate and liking of the manager (more likely when newly arrived) or by the contract flags. \n `game_check_players_missing_training()`, every day from the game's day loop. Starting from a random person (random(n − n/250 − 1)), n/250 consecutive people: a player (`.player()`, `.job_for_club()` = `job_kind::PLAYER`) with a contract and a club, present (`exe::awol_is_player_awol`), with the training record (`exe::training_manager_get_player_schedule`, `training_schedule::TYPE`) and without a serious injury (`exe::injury_get_player_injury_status` ≠ 2). (1) With `.professionalism()` < 8, player `.leadership()` < 8 and the sum (player `.leadership()`, `.age()`, `.professionalism()`, player `.work_rate()`, −5 if `.professionalism()` is 1, −5 if `.work_rate()` is 1, −5 if he dislikes the manager (`club::MANAGER`), +2 if he likes him) < 43: random(`.professionalism()` + 100, 50 or 25 depending on the days since `.date_joined_club()`: < 30, < 90, < 180) coming out zero is a miss. (2) Otherwise, with `.professionalism()` < 10 and a link with the club: the link flags (`contract::GRIEVANCES`: `grievances::UNHAPPY_WITH_TRAINING`, 0x30000; with `.professionalism()` < 5, 0x7800) give random(`.professionalism()`) draws that, when zero, are a miss. The miss: `exe::awol_miss_training`.

Returns the weight of language `code` for the person by his two nationalities (500/1000/300/100). \n The weight of language `code` for person `p` by his nation (`.nation()`) and second nation (`.second_nation()`): in the four special cases (`KEY_NATION_SWEDEN` with languages 0x16/0x20, `KEY_NATION_NORWAY` with 0x1e/0x20, `KEY_NATION_DENMARK` with 0x16/0x1e, `KEY_NATION_BELGIUM` with 7) and in the nation's languages `.second_language()`/`.third_language()`: 500/1000/500/300 by the first nation, 300/500/300/100 by the second; no nation, 0. The nation's first language (`nation::FIRST_LANGUAGE`) is not tested here. The caller at `0x7c0120` runs it for each language code and turns the weight into a fluency. Returns only `ax`.

Returns the club's season year: the previous year when today is before the season end day of its row. \n `key_nation_get_club_season_year(club)`: today's year (`G_CURRENT_DATE_YEAR`); for a club that is not a national team (`exe::database_is_national_team`), by the club's row (`exe::key_nation_index_of_club`): with the row's dword `key_nation_record::SPLIT_SEASON_FLAG` not zero or the end day (`key_nation_record::SEASON_END_DAY`, unsigned) below 60, and today's day (`G_CURRENT_DATE`, signed) before the end day, the previous year. The original returns only the low 16 bits meaningfully (the high ones are left over from the pushed slot). Called by the club records `0x444930`/`0x447430`/`0x448ad0` and the player history `0x7c3e40`/`0x7c5fe0`.

`Staff_Records::add_league_finish_records(league)`: at the end of the league, each club's final position in its manager's history. SEH frame only for the local date. Called by the completed league (`league_check_complete`). \n For each row of the table (`exe::league_get_table_row`, up to `.club_count()`), the history of the club's manager (`.manager()`; type 0xa: the club id, the competition of `.competition()`, the stage `.stage_id()` and the position k + 1), in the archive (0x58e340).

`Staff_Records::record_match_result(p, m)` (the fixture and the match): records a match in both managers' records. Called by the closing of the day's match (`close_day_match`), for each game. \n A friendly (`.category()` = `match_category::FRIENDLY`): nothing. The records of the two managers (+0xcf of the home side `.home_club()` and of the away side `.away_club()`; `get_manager_record` with create, through `club_manager_record`): +1 game (`manager_record::GAMES`); goals for (`.goals_for()`) and against (`.goals_against()`) from the score (`.home_goals_extra_time()`/`.away_goals_extra_time()`, or `.home_goals()`/`.away_goals()` with `.home_goals_extra_time()` = −1); win (`manager_record::WINS`, bonus 900), draw (`manager_record::DRAWS`, 300 for both) or loss (`manager_record::LOSSES`). Each one's rating (`get_fixture_match_importance` with 0 / 1, the opponent's reputation, the match points at +0x11f.. / +0x744..; importance × opponent reputation × weight × points) goes to `.year_points()` and `.month_points()` (month and year); in the club's league (`.division()` or `.reserve_division()` = the competition `.competition()`) also to the month's points (`manager_record::MONTH_LEAGUE_POINTS`); for a national team (`is_national_team`) to `.national_season_points()`, otherwise `.season_points()` (season). \n Defect of the original, reproduced: for the away manager, `.national_season_points()`/`.season_points()` receive the routine's [esp+0x10], which is the home manager's rating (or his bonus, without a record).

with 1 in 20, a recurring-capable injury becomes recurring in the record (`physical_record::RECURRING_TYPE` type, `physical_record::RECURRENCE_GRADE` = 0); among the recurring records, the best score (roll 0x65 − 5 × level − proneness, stops at 95): a player at a big club (reputation > 4250) without a human and 1 in 3 gets a new injury 0x4d/0x4e/0x4f (`exe::injury_add_injury`); otherwise his mark is cleared; it was turned off (DESLIGADAS) from 2026-10-29 to 2026-10-31 (the detour, even passing through, changed the stack residue a later original read: the career left be54a138); since the test criterion changed and the list was emptied, the copy runs again

Returns the match player's moment rating for his marking duty: `.moment_positioning()` when the marking type of his slot (`exe::formation_get_marking_type` of `.position()`) in his side's tactics block (`engine::TACTICS` + `formation_fields::SIZE` × side) has bit 2, otherwise `.moment_marking()`. Returns only `al`.

Checks that the offer keeps the club (with its partner) within 50 players and the coach (5), physio (3), scout (7) and assistant slots; a computer buyer without an exchange releases for free the cheapest player who can leave; otherwise reason 4 or 0x22 (plus 1 for the seller) and 0. Ret 0x10; the map gives it as stdcall, but the two call sites in `check_offer_restrictions` put the manager in ecx and it uses it for `count_club_free_transfer_queue` and `free_transfer_staff`: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::check_squad_limits(club, offer, count_queue, reason)`, from the offer restrictions (`check_offer_restrictions`), for the buyer and for the seller. Null club: the box at line 0x2c3b and 0. The club's partner (`exe::club_get_linked_b_team` with 0 and 1). For the buyer (`buyer_club_id()` of the offer = club id): the offer's person already belongs to it (contract of type 5, again through `exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, with the club; or the loan record `contract_record` with +4 = the club) counts −1; a player by the offer's type `job_type()` counts +1; a staff type by the same byte marks 1; each exchange player (`exchange_players()`, LLIST of ids) who leaves is discounted (player −1, staff −1 by the person's `staff::JOB_FOR_CLUB`). For the seller: without an exchange, 1; the player sold counts −1 and the staff type −1 (by `staff::JOB_FOR_CLUB`); each incoming exchange node adds by byte +6. A positive count: adds the 50 of the squad (+0xd7, pointers with a live id) of the club and of the partner; above 50, minus the club's free queue (`count_club_free_transfer_queue`) if `count_queue`; still above 50: other than a computer buyer without an exchange, the reason (club ≠ buyer) + 4 and 0; otherwise the cheapest of the squad ((`contract::HAPPINESS` of the contract + 100) × value `staff::VALUE`, with `contract::HAPPINESS` ≤ 0, without a sheet, without a type 5 contract in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`, without offers `get_offers_for_player`, exchanges `get_exchange_offers_for_player` or future transfer `get_future_transfer`, outside the free queue and with job (`staff::JOB_FOR_CLUB`) 0xb, 0xf or 0xd) leaves for free (`add_free_release_records` on `G_STAFF_RECORDS`, `free_transfer_staff` with −1); none, the reason + 4 and 0. Then the marked staff slots: 5 coaches (+0x19f), 3 physios (+0x1cf), 7 scouts (+0x1b3), those of the club counted by pointer and those of the partner only with a live id, and the assistant (`assistant_manager()` of the club or of the partner, occupied); over the limit, the reason + 0x22 and 0. Returns 1.

A club rejects the offer: counts the offer's attempt; by the refusing side, a random(2 × attempts) rejects or withdraws the offer, otherwise it is rescheduled with the delay news. Ret 0xc: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::club_rejects_offer(offer, club, reason)`: outside states 0x11/0x12 (`status()`), counts the attempt (`response_round`). Refusal by the buying club (id = `buyer_club_id()`): state 0x12 (`offer_status::REFUSED_BY_BUYER`); reason 8 (16 bits) reschedules (`schedule_offer` with 7, 0) and exits; otherwise, with no human club in the player's contract (`target_staff_id()`; contract in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`, `contract_type()` & 0x3f ≠ 5, `exe::human_manager_is_human_club`) and more than one attempt, a random(2 × attempts) different from 0 rejects the offer (`reject_transfer_offer` with the offer's address, 0, 6) and exits. Refusal by the other side: state 0x11 (`offer_status::REFUSED_BY_SELLING_SIDE`), unsettles the player (`unsettle_player_after_bid`); with reason 8, a computer buying club (`buyer_club_id()`) and a random(2 × attempts) different from 0 withdraw the offer (`withdraw_transfer_offer`) and it exits, otherwise it reschedules and exits (without the more-than-one-attempt test); with another reason, a computer buying club with more than one attempt and the same random draw withdraws the offer and exits. At the end: reschedules and gives the delay news (`post_transfer_delay_request_news` with the whole reason, as the original pushes it).

Updates the work permit on a move: when the new club needs a permit, updates the existing one (nation, year) or grants a new one (`add_work_permit`); otherwise removes any permit and re-sorts the array. Ret 8; SEH frame only for the local date: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::update_work_permit_on_move(person, club)`: if the player needs a permit at the new club (`player_needs_work_permit` with 1) and already has one: replaces the permit's nation (`work_permit::NATION_ID`) with the club's (`nation()`), zeroes `work_permit::MATCHES_PLAYED` and `work_permit::MATCHES_MISSED` and, if the nation changed, unless both nations are in region `world_region::UK_AND_IRELAND` (`actual_region()`), writes today's year (`work_permit::YEAR`); a club without a nation: the "Error" box 0x1dc2. Without a permit: the new one (`add_work_permit` with today's year, sorting), after today + 52 weeks (`exe::date_add_weeks`, unused). If he does not need one (`player_needs_work_permit` is called again) or without a club: removes whatever permit he has (flag 0x20, the last one in its place, count − 1 and re-sorts with `exe::crt_qsort`).

Decides the work permit: by the permit record (matches and refusals), a non-player by reputation, the 2001 exceptions, world reputation above 8500, wage above 34999, youth above 190, under 5 caps no, over 20 with a strong nation yes, and the 16-match national side history (over 11 or 70%), which advances with new matches. Ret 0x14: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::is_work_permit_granted(p, _nation, offer, record, sorteio)`, from the permit in the scouting list (`passes_work_permit_check`, without offer, record or random), from the accepted contract offer (`complete_accepted_contract_offer`, with the offer) and from the offer's permits (`check_offer_work_permits`). The person's contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, without writing `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`): of type 2 it is the "loan", otherwise the "contract". With the permit record (the given one, or found by binary search `exe::crt_bsearch` in `work_permits()`, count `work_permit_count()`, 14 bytes, when flag 0x20 exists): without an offer, granted if matches (`work_permit::MATCHES_PLAYED`) > 3 × refusals (`work_permit::MATCHES_MISSED`) or refusals < 4; with an offer, the same rule if the loan ends after the offer (`contract::CONTRACT_EXPIRES`) or the contract club is not the offer's (`contract::CLUB`), and granted if the loan does not end after. Non-player (`non_player()` without sheet `player()`): reputation (`world_reputation()`) above 160. In 2001, the two cases of Collin and Devon at Falkirk. World reputation (`world_reputation()` of the sheet) above 8500 (with random: 8000 + random(1000)); offer wage (`.wage()`) above 34999; under 24 years with ability (`potential_ability()`) above 190: granted. Fewer than 5 caps (`int_apps()`): not granted; more than 20 with the nation's reputation (`reputation()`) above 3000 and under 32 years: granted. The history advances with the national side's new matches (`[[G_NATIONAL_TEAMS]+4]` + nation id × 0x6e + 2; each one pushes a zero bit) and the count stays. The window: 16 matches, or those of the two-year period (`count_results_in_period`, up to 16) from 2003; with more than 11 matches marked (random: 11 − random(3) + random(3)) or more than 70% (70 − random(10) + random(10)): granted.

Counts the open negotiations of the player's club that include him in a part exchange and, if asked, lists the offer indices. Ret 8: goes through the negotiation slots (`.negotiations()`, `.negotiation_capacity()` of them, empty slots skipped) and counts those of the club of the player's contract (`buyer_club_id()`) whose offer (`[manager]` + 4 × `slot_index()`) is still open (states 2, 3, 4, 0x10 and 0x14 not; 0xf only with `response_round()` < 3) and that have the player in the exchange list (`exchange_players()`); with `out`, puts the offer index in it (`exe::llist_add_tail`, 4 bytes). A player outside the database or without a contract: 0.

Builds the cup's fixture tree: allocates the ties of each round, clears them, links each tie to a slot in the next round (by pair or drawn, the side by a coin toss; with no slot, two rounds ahead), puts each round's teams into its ties (drawn, the club whose stadium is the cup's venue at home) and numbers the first tie of each round. Returns 1. \n `Cup::map_fixture_tree()`, called when the cups are created (22 calls up to 2002-06-01). The tie arrays of each round (`exe::crt_malloc`: 4 per round and `0x35` per tie; out of memory, the "Memory Allocation Error" box of line `0x8b` or `0x9e` and the game stops; a round with no ties, the box of line `0x95` and -1); flag `+5` of each team (`team_table()`, 6 bytes) and `current_round()`/`next_draw_round()` cleared. With clubs (`season_set_up()`): each tie empty (the teams and the slots −1, `cup_tie::FEEDER_SIDE` = 0, `+0x14..+0x31` = `0xff`, `cup_tie::REPLAYS_PLAYED`..`cup_tie::FIXTURE_STATE` = 0). In the rounds up to the second-to-last (the third-to-last when the last is of type `0x8c`): the order of the ties (shuffled in drawn pairs if the next round has fewer than half); each one gets its slot in the next round: by pair (round `cup_round::TIE_RULES` bit `0x200`: p/2) or drawn (with bit `0x400`, the first fully free slot from there), the side by coin toss (`exe::utils_random(2)`; if taken, the next slot and another toss); with no free slot, a slot drawn two rounds ahead (without it, the game stops: lines `0x175` and `0x1a0`). The tie stores the slot (`cup_tie::FEEDER_TIE`), the side (`cup_tie::FEEDER_SIDE`: 1 home) and the destination round (`cup_tie::FEEDER_ROUND`); the slot stores the tie (`+0xa/+0xc`) and the source round (`+0xe/+0x10`). Then the teams of each round (`cup_round::NEW_TEAMS`, from `cup_round::FIRST_NEW_TEAM`) go into its ties: the first by pair or drawn (`tie_rules::SEEDED_DRAW`: the first fully free), the side by coin toss, and in a taken slot, with the cup's `venue_stadium_id()` set, the away team whose club stadium (`.stadium()`) is that venue becomes the home team (no slot: the box of line `0x1c2` or `0x222` and -1). With no ties in the first round, `run_by_stages` = 1. Finally the number of the first tie of each round (`cup_round::FIRST_TIE_NUMBER`), from back to front.

Computes the match attendance, writes the total, the home and the away crowd to `out` and returns the total. Convention: thiscall, ret 8, `stadium.cpp`; this = `G_STADIUM`; called by the match engine `0x6b7f20`. `calculate_match_attendance(game, out)` (fixture, output). With no fixture, `G_STADIUM_DEFAULT_ATTENDANCE` (15,000). R = club reputation (`club::REPUTATION`) / 500 (at least 1). For each side, the factor starts at the competition's reputation (`reputation()`, at least 1; with no competition 1), +2 in competitions of type 6, 8 and 10; in leagues (table `G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`, outside friendlies `exe::friendly_is_friendly_competition` and the nations of `FN_COMP_IS_RESERVE_OR_MINOR_COMP`, without `league::COMP_TYPE` = 2) plus the difference (`round_number()` of the fixture − `league::LEGS` of the league, between −6 and 5). The home factor times the away R / its own R (if it has R < 15 or below the other's), ×1.1 with the other above 17, ×1.25 with the other above 12 and it below 14; divided by the reputation of the club's league (`club::DIVISION` → `reputation()`), without one ×0.2 (type 10) or ×0.05. The away factor, the same with the roles swapped. Floors by competition type (apply_side_factor_floor: cups 8, 6 and 5 with the limits `+0x30`/`+0x32` and the reputation; 10 1.25; 9 0.8; otherwise 0.1). With a stadium off neutral ground: the cities of the stadium and of the two clubs (drawn when there is no city), the distance factor (`exe::stadium_get_travel_distance_factor`, at least 0.15); the home side gets the average (`attendance()`) × factor × distance, the away side (`attendance()` + `min_attendance()`) × factor × distance × 0.5; in the home club's league, by position (`exe::comp_stats_find_club_entry` on the league table): +50/100/150 × the league's reputation at the top, +25/50 × it in the race, −25/−10 × it at the bottom, and by form (`+0x72`/`+0x73`/`+0x74`); in the ground of a club's city, its crowd between the minimum (`min_attendance()`) and the maximum (`max_attendance()`). With no stadium or on neutral ground: average × factor. Derby (`club::RIVAL1`/`club::RIVAL2`/`club::RIVAL3`): ×1.5 (same city ×1.35); rival away side ×1.35; off neutral ground with `stage()` != `0xff` ×1.05 and ×0.85. In the league with `own_stadium()`: the minimum by the league's reputation (and the maximum with a reputation up to 4). A stadium with fewer than 1,500 seats becomes R × 1,000 (at least 1,500). Limits by capacity (the away side up to max(5%, min(capacity − away average × home factor, 15%)) and the home side the rest; neutral half), with no stadium 40,000 and 25,000; with no crowd, 1 to 50 and 1 to 15. Total = home + away − random(50) (negative: 45 to 194).

`player_search_get_club_target_rating(club, *base, *forced)` (cdecl): the rating the club looks for in players: a base from reputation, minimum attendance, division and continental competition, by bands, and adjustments for squad size and wealth; at least 500. The base (without `forced`): the reputation (`reputation()`), the attendance one (`min_attendance()` × 0.43 − 430, up to 10000, if greater than the reputation), the division one (`division()`: `competition::REPUTATION` × 500, if greater than reputation / 500) and the continental one (`continental_comp_id()` in `G_CLUB_COMP_TABLE`, 0x6b bytes: `reputation()` × 600, likewise), weighted and / 16; half at a non-professional club (`professional_status()` ≠ `professional_status::PROFESSIONAL`). The rating comes from the base by bands (up to 3000, 5000, 7000, 9000 and above). Without `forced`, by the squad (`database_count_club_squad`) and the wealth band of the finances (`exe::financetable_get_club_finance` of `G_FINANCE_TABLE`, `exe::finance_get_wealth_band`) for clubs whose division is in `G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`: a short squad (< 16) halves; < 20 halves, or 2/3 for the poor; otherwise it shrinks by the shortage of players compared with the division (its `competition::REPUTATION` × 1.35 + 20) and wealth pulls it (−2..2: × 0.909 or − 1000, × 0.952 or − 500, nothing, × 1.0125 or + 125, × 1.025 or + 250). At least 500. The base goes into `*base` (if not null). The floating-point arithmetic is in f64 (the game's x87 at 53 bits).

The seller accepts the bid: status 5; for a player job, target interest below 0.75 gives the refusal to move; exchange players wanting more than 1.5 times the seller's wage cap leave, with their value added to the fee; the offer goes to the next slice. Ret 8; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path (the local STAFF_CONTRACT of `construct_staff_contract`): `TRANSFER_MANAGER::accept_transfer_bid(slot, mark)`, the selling club accepts the bid. The target is `target_staff_id()`, the buyer `buyer_club_id()` and the seller the club of the target's contract (except type 5). `response_round` = 0; with `mark`, `player_aware` = 1 and the player marked as under offer in the scouting list (`mark_player_under_offer`: push +0 of the offer; push buyer; push target; mov ecx, `shortlist_manager()` -> thiscall, ret 0xc). `response_round` = 0, status 5 (`offer_status::ACCEPTED`); the count of human managers (`news_club_has_human_manager`, stdcall: ecx = `G_NEWS` is not read) between buyer and seller; the acceptance news (`post_offer_accepted_news`). 
 - Player job (`job_type()` = `job_kind::PLAYER`): the status the buyer would give (1 if human; otherwise `get_squad_status_for_club`: push 0; push buyer; push target, ret 0xc) goes in the low byte of the `mark` dword, and the target's interest (`staff_interest_in_joining_club`: push &reason; push that dword; push 0; push 0; push buyer; push target; mov ecx, `shortlist_manager()` -> thiscall, ret 0x18, returns ST0) below 0.75 (or NaN): the refusal to move (`post_player_rejects_move_news`: push reason; push offer, ret 8), status 0xf (`offer_status::COLLAPSED`), `response_round` = 3, the bids unmarked (`clear_bid_markers_for_player`), 10 days (`schedule_offer`), with the offer active and closed together with those of list +0 (`transfer_offer_closed`, stdcall) bit 0 of the target's 8-byte record in `person_flags()` cleared, and the status in the scouting list (`exe::shortlist_manager_find_club_shortlist_entry`: push 0; push type ≠ 0xb; push target; push buyer, ret 0x10; found, `update_staff_status`: push the dword with the low byte = role ≠ 0xb and the high bytes from the entry pointer; push 1; push buyer; push target, ret 0x10). End. 
 - Otherwise, each exchange player (`exchange_players()`): human seller, +5 = 2; his desired contract (`exe::staff_contract_set_to_desired_contract`: push 0; push 0; push 0xb; push +5 (only the byte is read); push −1; push seller; push person; lea ecx, contract -> thiscall, ret 0x1c) and the seller's wage cap (`get_club_finance`: push seller; mov ecx, `G_FINANCE_TABLE`, ret 4; `get_max_wage`: push +5; push person; mov ecx, finances, ret 8): cap × 1.5 below the wage, he leaves the exchange: his value (`calc_player_value`: push 0; push −1; push 0; push buyer; push person; mov ecx, `G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`, ret 0x14) is added to `fee()`, the news (`exe::transfer_manager_post_swap_player_rejects_news`: push value; push person; push offer, ret 0xc), removal from the list (`manager_manager_remove`: push node; mov ecx, list, ret 4), byte +2 of his record in `person_flags()` drops 1; with an AI seller, the AI's answer (`ai_respond_to_bid`: push 1; push slot, ret 8) and, if the offer is active, the empty exchange is freed and end. At the end of the list, the empty exchange is freed. 
 - Human manager: the contract talks news (`post_contract_talks_news`); the offer rescheduled for the next slice (`schedule_offer`: push 1; push 0); with an exchange and an AI seller, each exchange player's entry in the seller's list (`exe::shortlist_manager_find_club_shortlist_entry` with 0, 0) receives the offer's index `slot_index()` in `shortlist_slot::OFFER_REF`.
